name: Realtime-Venus (Omni and Audio checkpoints)
purpose: Full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation: keeps perceiving while speaking, proactively responds to audio-video events, emits in-stream <delegate> requests to external tools and has a training-free long-video memory (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo is the Apache License 2.0 (header opened).

architecture.kind: streaming multimodal causal model with custom Transformers code; parameter count not read

variants.notes: HF API reports 640 GB for the repo (it also carries data/benchmark arrays), so the weights' size is not derivable from that

other: Transformers custom code; Realtime-Venus-Harness for delegation in the project's repository

strengths: native full duplex, proactive responses on video
weaknesses: card text read does not give size or benchmark numbers

tona_fit.reason: Interesting full-duplex design, but nothing readable about size or quality; revisit when a size is known.
